definitions.gloss: Obon holiday; summer vacation period around mid-August
definitions.explanation: The period of time off work or school during the Obon festival, typically around August 13-16, when many people return to their hometowns.

examples.japanese: お{盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm going back to my hometown for the Obon holiday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何日間|なんにちかん}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many days is this year's Obon holiday?

examples.japanese: お{盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{混|こ}む→混む：02574_komu⟧。
examples.english: The highways get very congested during the Obon holiday period.

notes:
One of the three major holiday periods in Japan, along with ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧ (New Year) and ⟦ゴールデンウィーク→ゴールデンウィーク：22760_goorudenwiiku⟧ (Golden Week). Most companies give employees several days off, and it is customary to return to one's hometown to visit family graves and spend time with relatives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to start the Obon holiday
- お{盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: during the Obon holiday
- お{盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take the Obon holiday off
- お{盆休|ぼんやす}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{帰省|きせい}ラッシュ→帰省ラッシュ：15594_kiseirasshu⟧: the homecoming rush during Obon

CULTURAL NOTE:
Obon is a Buddhist tradition honoring the spirits of ancestors. During this period, families clean graves, make offerings, and some regions hold ⟦{盆踊|ぼんおど}り→盆踊り：05638_bonodori⟧ (Bon dances). The travel rush before and after お{盆休|ぼんやす}み causes major traffic jams and crowded trains, which are widely reported in the news each year.
